description: This source file implements a command-line tool for managing a disk cache, including listing keys, calculating size, retrieving streams, updating headers, and deleting entries. It supports both argument-based and stream-based command interfaces.

classes.name: CommandMarshal
classes.description: Abstract base class for command input/output handling, supporting both argument-based and stream-based interfaces.

classes.name: ProgramArgumentCommandMarshal
classes.description: Handles command I/O via command-line arguments and standard output for user-readable interaction.

classes.name: StreamCommandMarshal
classes.description: Handles command I/O via pickled data over stdin/stdout for automated processing.

methods.name: PrintHelp
methods.description: Prints help information about the cachetool commands.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total size of all cache entries.

methods.name: GetResponseInfoForEntry
methods.description: Retrieves HTTP response info from a cache entry.

methods.name: GetMD5ForResponseBody
methods.description: Computes MD5 hash of a cache entry's response body.

methods.name: PersistResponseInfo
methods.description: Persists HTTP response info into a cache entry.

methods.name: ListDups
methods.description: Finds and lists duplicate resources in the cache based on response body MD5 hashes.

methods.name: GetStreamForKeyBuffer
methods.description: Reads a cache entry's stream into a buffer.

methods.name: GetStreamForKey
methods.description: Outputs a cache entry's stream or response info.

methods.name: UpdateRawResponseHeaders
methods.description: Updates raw response headers for a cache entry.

methods.name: SetHeader
methods.description: Sets a specific header in a cache entry's response headers.

methods.name: DeleteStreamForKey
methods.description: Deletes a specific stream from a cache entry.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: ExecuteCommands
methods.description: Main loop executing cache management commands based on input.
